source: Public Calingasta corridor anchors and McEwen Los Azules elevation context
method: Public locality/project elevation context mapped to the versioned reconstructed route axis with interpolation between anchors.
limitations: Analytical aid only; intermediate elevations are interpolated and are not an engineering-grade terrain survey.
